staticGeometryPipeline.finding: Scripts in scripts/build-geo-assets.mjs process GeoJSON files from apps/mobile/data/ into apps/api/public/geo/ with 5-decimal coordinate rounding, consecutive-duplicate point stripping, minification, and gzip compression.

assemblyGeometryEndpoints.finding: apps/api/src/routes/geo.ts exposes GET /geo/manifest.json and GET /geo/:file (strictly /^[a-z0-9-]+\.json$/). In addition, apps/api/src/routes/constituencies.ts exposes GET /constituencies/locate performing in-memory point-in-polygon lookup strictly for a single state fixture using a hardcoded local file.

mobileConsumption.finding: apps/mobile/lib/geoLoader.ts bundles India overview ('IN') synchronously; apps/mobile/lib/remoteGeoLoader.ts downloads per-state assembly files on demand using Expo FileSystem and stores them in local disk cache (CACHE_DIR) with memCache de-duplication; apps/mobile/lib/enrichedGeoCache.ts merges demographic/party data before passing directly to MapboxGL.ShapeSource.

geometryFileFormats.finding: Standard WGS84 (SRID 4326) GeoJSON FeatureCollections containing Polygon or MultiPolygon geometries. Features contain basic properties. Sanitized at load time via sanitizeGeoJSON() to eliminate rings with <4 positions to prevent native MapLibre crashes.

cachingStrategy.finding: Four-tier caching: Tier 1 (JS bundle inlining for 'IN'), Tier 2 (memCache Map in JavaScript heap), Tier 3 (expo-file-system disk cache keyed by state and 12-char SHA-1 version), Tier 4 (HTTP Cache-Control headers on Fastify).

httpCacheHeaders.finding: GET /geo/:file with ?v=<hash> emits 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable'. Bare requests emit 'public, max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800'. GET /api/v1/states/* emits 'public, max-age=300, s-maxage=300'.

cdnRailwayBehavior.finding: Production API is hosted on Railway (kshetra-api-production-9f06.up.railway.app). No dedicated edge CDN is currently evidenced in code or DNS configuration in the repository. Fastify acts as direct origin.

apiAuthenticationModel.finding: Public spatial routes permit unauthenticated public access. Administrative routes require Bearer tokens or debug bypass secrets. PostgREST public.entity_geometries has RLS enabled with GRANT SELECT TO anon, authenticated and REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE.

publicReadPatterns.finding: Mobile app reads static GeoJSON and state/constituency feeds anonymously without auth headers. All geographic boundaries currently rendered in UI are public-domain cartographic datasets.

errorLoadingEmptySemantics.finding: Fastify returns structured errors via sendApiError. remoteGeoLoader throws on non-200. enrichedGeoCache falls back to un-enriched raw GeoJSON if data enrichment throws. MapLibre renders a blank canvas if malformed geometry is passed.

mobileMemoryPerformanceConstraints.finding: Mobile app parses entire per-state GeoJSON files into JavaScript memory. No LRU eviction exists in memCache. Passing large GeoJSON across React Native bridge to MapLibre ShapeSource causes UI thread pauses on lower-end devices.

databaseAccessPatterns.finding: Mobile client queries Supabase PostgREST directly for 22 Class-A read models. Fastify backend connects directly to PostgreSQL. public.entity_geometries is currently untouched by application routes or mobile services.

regimeA_Current.description: Default active statutory geography currently in legal effect
regimeA_Current.sqlPredicate: is_current = true AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > CURRENT_DATE) AND temporal_classification != 'scenario'
regimeA_Current.failClosedRule: Returns 404 if entity has no active statutory version; never substitutes historical or scenario version.

regimeB_Historical.description: Statutory geography as it legally existed on a specific historical date
regimeB_Historical.sqlPredicate: valid_from <= :as_of_date::date AND (valid_to > :as_of_date::date OR valid_to IS NULL) AND temporal_classification = 'historical_statutory_baseline'
regimeB_Historical.failClosedRule: Returns 404 if entity was unformed or dissolved at as_of_date. Header x-geography-temporal-classification: historical.

regimeC_ExplicitVersion.description: Direct fetch of a specific immutable version record by UUID or version code
regimeC_ExplicitVersion.failClosedRule: Strict 404 if record does not exist.

regimeD_FutureRegime.description: Statutorily enacted future geography regime not yet in active effect
regimeD_FutureRegime.sqlPredicate: delimitation_regime_id = :regime_id AND valid_from > CURRENT_DATE AND is_current = false
regimeD_FutureRegime.failClosedRule: Header x-geography-regime: future_enacted. Prohibited from mixing with active current geography.

regimeE_Scenario.description: Hypothetical simulation or draft boundary proposal
regimeE_Scenario.failClosedRule: Quarantined into dedicated /api/v1/geo/scenarios/* routes; prohibited from default public routes.

canonicalGeometry.authority: Authoritative single source of truth; immutable coordinates protected by trigger
canonicalGeometry.governance: Anchored to W012 provenance records and dataset versions

deliveryGeometry.store: Derived Vector Tiles (MVT / PMTiles) or simplified GeoJSON
deliveryGeometry.authority: Downstream delivery representation; never an independent source of truth

edgeLayerRequirements.rangeRequests: Strict compliance with RFC 7233 (HTTP 206 Partial Content) for PMTiles byte-range serving
edgeLayerRequirements.compression: Brotli and Gzip compression on dynamic and static responses
edgeLayerRequirements.cacheControl: Strict obedience to origin Cache-Control headers (immutable, s-maxage, stale-while-revalidate)
edgeLayerRequirements.geographicPoPs: Point-of-Presence coverage across major Indian internet exchange hubs (Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad)
edgeLayerRequirements.performanceTarget: Future measurable acceptance target: P95 < 50ms at edge PoP under 1,000 req/sec

qualitativeCostOperations.postGisCompute: Minimized by offloading map rendering to pre-generated tiles; DB handles only point queries
qualitativeCostOperations.apiCompute: Lightweight Fastify node instances handle reverse geocoding and metadata queries
qualitativeCostOperations.objectStorage: Highly cost-effective storage of compressed PMTiles archives or MVT directories
qualitativeCostOperations.cdnLayer: High cache-hit ratio (>95%) drastically lowers origin bandwidth and compute bills
qualitativeCostOperations.tileGeneration: Batch compute executed upon new dataset version ingestion, not on customer request paths
qualitativeCostOperations.bandwidth: Binary Protocol Buffers reduce mobile wire transfer by 70-80% compared to GeoJSON
qualitativeCostOperations.observability: Standard OpenTelemetry metrics and error tracking integrated with Fastify server
